497:t_008:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I hope he never shows himself before us again...」

497:t_008:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So he... believed in the god of space too?」

497:t_008:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Only humans have the power to change God... to change the future... That is the god called possibility.」

497:t_008:8.en:
$$シャア$$
(I'm sorry, $$ギュネイ$$... My own shortcomings made you suffer...)

497:t_008:9.en:
$$シャア$$
(I've made up my mind too. In this battle...)

497:t_008:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Watch out! The main force is coming!」

497:t_009:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That purple unit...! Is that Captain $$アンジェロ$$?!」

497:t_009:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Damn $$ギュネイ$$. I entrusted the vanguard to him, but it seems he barely achieved any results.」

497:t_009:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Never mind. I won't lose to a $c that has split up its forces.」

497:t_009:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$カミーユ$$... Concentrate your attacks on that commander unit.」

497:t_009:8.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Here I come, $c...! I'll crush you here and finish off the fools who defy the Colonel all at once!」

497:t_010:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I've finally gotten used to the $$ローゼン・ズール$$ the Colonel gave me...! With this, I can do it!」

497:t_010:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That man...! Has he sworn personal loyalty to $$フル・フロンタル$$...!」

497:t_010:2.en:
$$シン$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ fought for personal reasons too, but this guy is even worse!」

497:t_010:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Being lumped in with that incompetent is insulting!」

497:t_012:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$ギュネイ・ガス$$! What is the meaning of this!?」

497:t_012:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Big talk from someone who can't even dodge an incompetent's funnels.」

497:t_012:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That was a warning. The next one will be a direct hit, $$アンジェロ$$.」

497:t_012:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You bastard! Do you intend to defect from $$ネオ・ジオン$$!?」

497:t_012:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The enemy I fight is not $$ジオン$$! It's $$フル・フロンタル$$, who wagged his tail at the $$サイデリアル$$, and those who follow him!」

497:t_012:8.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「It's not because you or $$カミーユ$$ told me to.」

497:t_012:9.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I always knew in my own heart that this day would come someday. It just happens to be today.」

497:t_012:12.en:
$$キラ$$
「He understood us, so that's enough.」

497:t_012:14.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$ギュネイ・ガス$$! You have disgraced the name of $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

497:t_012:15.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「It's $$フロンタル$$, who forgot his pride as a human being, who did that!」

497:t_012:16.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Let's go, $$アンジェロ$$! I'll change $$ネオ・ジオン$$ my own way!」

497:t_013:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Tch! Are you saying I can't master the $$ローゼン・ズール$$!?」

497:t_013:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Retreat! All units, follow me!」

497:t_016:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$! Have you come to finish me off!?」

497:t_016:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$... I am surrendering to you now.」

497:t_016:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you serious!? What the hell for!?」

497:t_016:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「...Very well. If I capture you, the Colonel will be pleased.」

497:t_016:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「I have surrendered. I'd ask that you not forget that.」

497:t_016:10.en:
$$シャア$$
($$アムロ$$... I leave the rest to you.)

497:t_017:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「H-hey! Is he going to become $$ジオン$$'s $$赤い彗星$$ again!?」

497:t_017:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$ intends to make contact with $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

497:t_017:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Probably to learn his own possibilities...」

497:t_017:7.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Making pathetic noises, $$カミーユ$$. Can't you do anything without the Colonel?」

497:t_017:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「No... You're right, $$ギュネイ$$.」

497:t_017:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Colonel... We believe in you.)

497:t_017:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(You will surely come back... So we will keep fighting our own battle.)

497:t_018:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「H-hey! Is he going to become $$ジオン$$'s $$赤い彗星$$ again!?」

497:t_018:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$ intends to make contact with $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

497:t_018:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Probably to learn his own possibilities...」

497:t_018:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Colonel... We believe in you.)

497:t_018:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(You will surely come back... So we will keep fighting our own battle.)

497:t_019:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're persistent, $$カミーユ$$! You and I are enemies!」

497:t_019:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But we have no reason to fight! Even you can't believe that this is good for humanity!」
